name: devbox
changelog: v1: rootless-podman container-host tile with an SSH proxy into container shells
title: Devbox (containers + SSH)
description: Spin up rootless Podman containers as dev sandboxes and SSH straight into any of them — the container name is the SSH user (ssh -p<port> <name>@<host>). Manage containers and your authorized SSH keys from the tile. Needs the admin-only cap:containers grant, a net binding for container egress, and its SSH port published to a host port via ingress. A worked example of a container-host tile (plans/containers.md).
